job.title: Regional Sales/ Team Lead
job.description:
The Opportunity
We are partnering with a leading multinational FMCG organisation to appoint a Regional Team Lead, Indirect Trade, based in Penang.

This is a senior commercial leadership role responsible for driving distributor and customer development performance across Kedah, Perak and Malacca. The successful candidate will lead a team of three Key Account Managers, strengthen distributor partnerships, and drive sales, distribution, profitability, and market share across the assigned territories.

The role offers significant ownership of the region's commercial performance and requires a strong combination of distributor management, General Trade expertise, people leadership and strategic customer development.

About the Company
Our client is a globally recognised FMCG organisation with an established portfolio of market-leading consumer brands. With a strong presence across international markets, the organisation continues to invest in its commercial capabilities, people development and route-to-market excellence.
 
Key Responsibilities
Commercial & Distributor Leadership
  • Lead the commercial strategy and performance of distributor partners across Kedah, Perak and Malacca.
  • Drive sales, volume, distribution, profitability and market share objectives across the assigned territories.
  • Develop strategic distributor and customer plans to strengthen route-to-market effectiveness and identify new growth opportunities.
  • Build strong relationships with distributor leadership and key customers to drive sustainable, mutually beneficial partnerships.
  • Lead complex commercial negotiations and resolve channel challenges effectively.

Customer Development & Market Execution
  • Drive strong General Trade execution across distribution, assortment, pricing, placement and in-store visibility.
  • Monitor customer, category, competitor and market developments to identify opportunities and potential business risks.
  • Translate market and customer insights into actionable commercial strategies.
  • Ensure distributor and customer activities are aligned with broader customer development and business priorities.

Team Leadership & Capability Development
  • Lead, coach and develop three Key Account Managers, providing clear direction and accountability against commercial objectives.
  • Establish individual and team KPIs and regularly review performance against agreed targets.
  • Provide ongoing coaching, feedback and development to strengthen commercial and customer management capabilities.
  • Build a high-performance team culture focused on ownership, collaboration and execution excellence.
  • Support individual development and succession planning across the team.

Strategic & Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Represent the region's commercial perspective in broader business planning and strategic discussions.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to ensure customer and market realities are incorporated into commercial plans.
  • Provide senior leadership with clear market insights, performance updates and strategic recommendations.
  • Ensure alignment between distributor priorities, customer requirements and organisational objectives.
 
Requirements
  • Bachelor's Degree in Business, Marketing, Commerce or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 10 years of commercial experience, with strong exposure to distributor management, customer development, sales or General Trade within FMCG.
  • Proven understanding of Malaysia's General Trade and distributor landscape, ideally with exposure to Northern and/or West Malaysia markets.
  • Strong experience managing distributor relationships and driving commercial performance across multiple territories.
  • Demonstrated people leadership experience, with the ability to coach and develop Key Account or Customer Development teams.
  • Strong understanding of route-to-market strategy, retail execution and customer development.
  • Excellent commercial acumen with the ability to translate market insights into actionable growth strategies.
  • Strong negotiation and influencing capabilities, including experience managing complex distributor and channel discussions.
  • Excellent stakeholder management, communication and presentation skills.
  • Results-oriented and comfortable operating independently across a geographically dispersed territory.
  • This position will be based in Penang, with regular travel across the assigned markets as required.

What's on Offer
  • Senior commercial leadership opportunity within a leading multinational FMCG organisation.
  • Ownership of key distributor markets across Kedah, Perak and Malacca.
  • Opportunity to lead and develop a team of Key Account Managers.
  • Strong exposure to distributor strategy, General Trade and route-to-market development.
  • Competitive remuneration package with long-term career development opportunities.

job.description:
• Senior Change Analyst

  • Contract until: 31 March 2027

We are seeking an experienced Senior Change Analyst to support a major digital transformation program focused on improving customer experience, data visibility and service delivery. The program is implementing a new Salesforce-based CRM platform, bringing together information currently held across multiple systems to provide a more complete view of the customer journey. The transformation will enable improved engagement, more proactive service delivery and better use of customer data across the organisation.

Working as part of an established transformation team, the Change Analyst will support the development and execution of change activities across a broad and diverse stakeholder group.

Key responsibilities
  • Undertake detailed change impact assessments across business processes, systems, roles and ways of working
  • Identify impacted stakeholder groups and assess change readiness, risks and adoption requirements
  • Support the development and delivery of the change and adoption strategy
  • Develop stakeholder engagement, communications and change plans
  • Facilitate workshops and consultation sessions with business stakeholders and SMEs
  • Gather feedback and translate business impacts into practical change interventions
  • Support readiness and adoption activities ahead of implementation and go-live
  • Work closely with Change Managers, Project Managers, Business Analysts, Product and technology teams
  • Assist with the development of communications, training and supporting change materials
  • Monitor change risks, issues, readiness and adoption and provide regular reporting to program stakeholders
  • Help ensure new processes and ways of working are successfully embedded across the organisation
Key skills and experience required: 
  • Strong experience as a Change Analyst on large digital, CRM or enterprise transformation programs
  • Demonstrated experience conducting change impact and stakeholder assessments
  • Strong stakeholder engagement and workshop facilitation skills
  • Experience supporting communications, training, readiness and adoption activities
  • An understanding of structured change methodologies and frameworks
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate complex transformation impacts into clear actions
  • Experience working across business and technology teams in complex stakeholder environments
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Experience with Salesforce or CRM transformation programs will be highly regarded
This is an excellent opportunity to join a significant transformation program delivering a new digital platform that will materially improve customer experience and service delivery. if this matches your skill-set and experience, please apply NOW and you will be contacted for a further discussion if your profile is deemed a suitable match.

job.title: AI Engineering Lead (GenAI & Supply Chain Platforms)
job.description:
Role Type: Full-Time
Budget: 195,000/annum
 
Client introduction
Our client is an established Singapore-headquartered supply chain software company with a strong footprint across Asia Pacific. Its software supports complex warehouse, transport, order and broader logistics operations for enterprise customers across the region.

As part of a wider technology transformation, the business is moving its Generative AI capability beyond experimentation and into production. They are hiring a AI Engineering Lead (GenAI & Supply Chain Platforms) to take an existing LLM platform from proof of concept into a production-grade capability, modernise parts of the existing application estate and build out an internal AI engineering function.

The role reports directly to the CEO and carries responsibility across AI engineering, platform, DevOps and infrastructure.
 
Job responsibilities
  • Take technical ownership of the company's Generative AI capability and drive it from proof of concept into a stable, scalable production environment.
  • Lead the design and delivery of LLM-based solutions across areas such as RAG, agentic workflows, enterprise integration and AI-enabled applications.
  • Set the technical direction for how AI is introduced across the wider software estate, spanning both modernisation of existing applications and new development.
  • Guide the integration of legacy Java-based systems with newer cloud-native and AI-enabled components as the technology estate evolves.
  • Lead the existing DevOps and infrastructure/server operations teams while progressively building the internal AI engineering capability and developing existing technical staff.
  • Establish practical engineering standards across API and integration design, model evaluation, security and privacy, observability and MLOps.
  • Evaluate cloud AI platforms, frameworks and supporting technologies, working with selected technology partners where external expertise is required.
  • Work closely with product and business stakeholders to identify where AI can improve existing products or enable new capabilities.
 
Job requirements
  • Strong background in software, platform or AI engineering, with the technical depth to operate credibly alongside engineers rather than oversee from a distance.
  • Supply chain, logistics, manufacturing or enterprise SaaS experience would be advantageous but is not essential.
  • Has taken a Generative AI or LLM-based system into a genuine production environment, with enough technical depth to explain the architecture, engineering decisions and production challenges in detail. Pilots and proofs of concept alone would not be sufficient.
  • Practical understanding of modern LLM patterns including retrieval-augmented generation, agentic workflows, embeddings, vector search, prompt design and model evaluation.
  • Hands-on exposure to major cloud AI platforms such as Azure OpenAI, Google Vertex AI or AWS Bedrock.
  • Strong understanding of APIs, data pipelines, event-driven integration and how AI services integrate with existing enterprise applications.
  • Experience leading multidisciplinary engineering, platform, DevOps or infrastructure teams.
  • Track record of application modernisation or technology transformation, particularly where legacy and modern systems need to coexist.
 
Why you should join them
This is an opportunity to build an AI engineering capability from the ground up within an established regional technology business. The groundwork already exists, but the next phase is about taking that work into production and embedding AI into real products and operations.

Unlike many senior AI positions centred primarily on strategy or governance, this role combines building, modernising and leading. The successful candidate will have direct ownership of the technology, an existing platform organisation to lead and the mandate to establish the company's internal AI engineering capability.

Reporting directly to the CEO, they will have significant influence over how the company's technology estate evolves and how Generative AI is applied across its products in the years ahead.

Our client is an established Singapore-headquartered supply chain software company with a strong footprint across Asia Pacific. Their platforms support warehouse, transport, order and dock management alongside broader logistics operations, serving enterprise customers across multiple industries and regional markets.
On the back of strong new customer growth, they are hiring a hands-on Program Manager to own customer delivery end to end - from implementation through to ongoing support and service management - while leading a team spanning Project Management, Business Analysis and L1/L2 customer support.

Job responsibilities
  • Take end-to-end ownership of customer implementations, from sales handover through requirements, implementation, testing, go-live and stabilization.
  • Own project scope, timelines, budget and P&L - once a deal is signed, take ownership of the agreed budget, scope and timeline and drive delivery and profitability from there.
  • Manage multiple customer projects across different countries and supply chain solutions.
  • Lead and develop a team of approximately 12 to 15 across Project Management, Business Analysis and L1/L2 customer support.
  • Stay hands-on with key projects, customer discussions, escalations and delivery issues rather than operating purely at a governance level.
  • Oversee post-go-live support and service delivery, including SLAs, major incidents, problem management and regular service reviews.
  • Coordinate with Product, Development, Infrastructure and Support teams to deliver projects and resolve customer issues.
  • Act as a senior escalation point and build strong long-term relationships with customer stakeholders.
  • Work with customers to understand their supply chain processes and identify where AI, automation or digital solutions could improve their workflows, channelling relevant opportunities to the appropriate internal teams.
  • Drive improvements to customer onboarding, delivery methods and support operations to improve speed, quality and overall delivery performance.
 
Job requirements
  • At least 8 years of experience in customer-facing project or program management, technology delivery, implementation or service delivery.
  • Strong understanding of supply chain and logistics operations. Experience with WMS, TMS, OMS or similar platforms would be highly relevant.
  • Track record of delivering enterprise customer implementations, preferably across multiple countries or regional environments.
  • Experience leading Project Managers, Business Analysts and/or customer support teams.
  • Strong project-management fundamentals across scope, schedule, budget, resources, risk and stakeholder management.
  • Experience carrying project P&L, with good commercial awareness across budgets, change requests, billing and project profitability.
  • Solid understanding of service management, including SLAs, customer escalations, incident management and problem management.
  • Strong customer-facing skills with the confidence to engage senior customer stakeholders.
  • Practical understanding of AI, automation or digital-transformation concepts and the ability to identify relevant customer use cases; deep AI engineering expertise is not required.
 
Why you should join them
This is a newly created, growth-driven role reporting directly to the CEO, with broad ownership across the entire customer lifecycle.

Rather than owning a single slice of delivery, the Program Manager takes responsibility from onboarding through go-live and into ongoing service - genuine ownership of both the build and the run, backed by P&L accountability for the projects they deliver.

The role also provides the opportunity to lead across Project Management, Business Analysis and customer support, and directly influence how the business delivers to its customers.

It suits a delivery leader who wants to stay close to customers and projects while leading a sizeable team - offering breadth, ownership and direct impact rather than a narrow or purely administrative remit.

job.description:
Location: Hybrid – Sydney
Snr Cyber Security Engineer – Zscaler Specialist

About the Role
Our client, a large enterprise operating in a highly regulated industry, is looking for a Cyber Security Engineer to join their security team with a strong focus on Zscaler. You'll provide expert technical support across the organisation's Zscaler SASE platform (ZIA, ZPA and ZDX), ensuring secure, reliable and high-performing connectivity for the business. This role suits someone who is hands-on, technically strong, and comfortable being the go-to Zscaler expert within a broader security operations function.

What You'll Be Doing
- Acting as the subject matter expert for Zscaler ZIA, ZPA and ZDX, providing advanced technical support, troubleshooting and day-to-day platform administration
- Managing policy configuration, traffic steering, tunnel connectivity (GRE/IPsec) and PoP routing across the Zscaler environment
- Diagnosing and resolving complex connectivity, authentication, latency and application performance issues across endpoint, network and cloud layers
- Supporting Zscaler platform upgrades, maintenance windows and operational changes
- Contributing to Zscaler implementation and onboarding activities, including policy design, migrations and rollout of new capabilities (implementation experience highly regarded, though the core focus is technical support)
- Collaborating with network, security, endpoint and application teams to resolve SASE-related incidents and align on security policy changes
- Supporting compliance reporting, audit evidence and security posture reviews in line with a highly regulated environment
- Preparing incident trend and security posture reporting for internal stakeholders

About You
- Strong, demonstrable hands-on experience with Zscaler (ZIA/ZPA/ZDX) is essential — this is a Zscaler-focused role and prior platform exposure is a must
- Experience working in a highly regulated industry, with an understanding of frameworks such as Essential Eight and ISO 27001
- Solid grounding in network and security fundamentals — firewalls (Check Point, Fortinet, Palo Alto or similar), VPNs/IPSec, IDS/IPS
- Exposure to complementary security tooling such as SIEM, cloud security platforms, PAM or endpoint security is beneficial
- Zscaler implementation or migration project experience is a strong plus, but not mandatory
- Strong communicator, comfortable working across technical and non-technical stakeholders in a fast-paced enterprise environment

job.title: Product Manager (WMS/TMS Product Modernisation)
job.description:
Client introduction
Our client is an established Singapore-headquartered supply chain software company with a strong footprint across Asia Pacific. It builds and operates its own software suite supporting complex logistics operations, spanning Warehouse Management, Transport Management, Order Management and related supply chain processes, used by enterprise customers across the region.

Having grown over many years by responding to individual customer requirements, the business is now moving deliberately towards a more structured, product-led model. A newly created Product Manager position has been established to bring clear roadmap ownership and product discipline to how its core platforms are developed going forward.
The role reports directly to the CEO and is an individual contributor position with high visibility across the organisation.

Job responsibilities
  • Own the product direction and roadmap for the core supply chain applications, with an initial focus on Transport Management and Warehouse Management, alongside selected Order Management capabilities.
  • Lead the modernisation of a product estate that has evolved over many years, with an early focus on improving product usability, user experience, functionality and how new capabilities are delivered.
  • Bring greater structure and product discipline into an organisation with deep operational and domain expertise, where formal product-management practices are still developing.
  • Assess existing products and identify where functionality, user experience, workflows and delivery can be improved, without unnecessarily rebuilding the underlying architecture.
  • Develop and prioritise a practical roadmap covering enhancements, modernisation initiatives and new capabilities.
  • Work with engineering to translate product priorities into clear requirements, releases and delivery plans.
  • Partner with UX and design to lift the usability and overall experience of the applications.
  • Work with Sales and Account Management to understand evolving customer and market demand, including growing interest in AI, and feed the relevant themes into the roadmap.
  • Assess how AI and emerging technologies, including automation, analytics and agentic AI, can be applied across existing and future products.
  • Give senior leadership clear visibility of product priorities, progress, dependencies and direction.
 
This is an internally focused product role. Customer insight comes largely through the sales and account teams rather than direct customer ownership, and the focus is on product-led modernisation of the existing suite rather than re-architecting the underlying platforms.

Job requirements
  • Solid product management or product ownership experience, with demonstrated ownership of roadmaps and prioritisation.
  • Experience with supply chain or logistics software, ideally Transport Management (TMS) and/or Warehouse Management (WMS) systems. Order Management (OMS) exposure is an advantage.
  • A background on the technology, software or product side of the industry rather than primarily logistics operations or supply chain business functions.
  • A track record of turning business and market demand into structured product plans, requirements and priorities.
  • Experience improving or modernising established software products, particularly around functionality, UI/UX, product consistency and delivery.
  • Enough technical fluency to work credibly with engineering on integrations, APIs and data, without needing to be an engineer.
  • A good grasp of current AI developments, including generative AI, agentic workflows, intelligent automation and predictive capabilities, and how to apply them in enterprise products. Hands-on AI delivery is a plus, but strong applied understanding and the ability to build AI into a roadmap matter just as much.
 
Why you should join them
This is a chance to take a real product-building mandate rather than inherit a fixed feature backlog. The organisation is making a deliberate shift from customer-driven development towards a structured product model, so there is genuine scope to shape how its core supply chain platforms evolve and how product decisions get made.

The role reports directly to the CEO and works on WMS and TMS products already live across regional markets. The focus is not a wholesale technology rebuild but making established products materially better in usability, delivery and direction, while introducing newer capabilities, including AI, where they add real value.

For someone who wants to bring structure to an established product environment and take meaningful ownership of how a core product suite evolves, there is considerable room to make an impact.

job.title: Actuarial Pricing Analyst (fixed term contract)
job.description:
Ethos BeathChapman is partnering with a leading general insurer to appoint an Actuarial Pricing Specialist.

This is a fantastic opportunity for an actuarial pricing specialist with general insurance pricing experience who enjoys balancing technical modelling, pricing governance, portfolio insights, and stakeholder engagement. You will play a critical role in ensuring pricing models remain robust, compliant, and commercially effective, while providing valuable insights that influence underwriting and portfolio management decisions.  Working closely with Pricing Actuaries, Underwriting Leaders, and senior stakeholders, you'll contribute to the development of pricing capability and help drive sustainable portfolio performance.

As an Actuarial Pricing Specialist, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining pricing models, supporting pricing governance frameworks, delivering large-risk pricing solutions, and providing meaningful analysis on rate adequacy and portfolio performance.

You will also play a key role in governance activities, regulatory reporting, audits, and pricing reviews, helping ensure adherence to internal standards and industry best practices.

Key Responsibilities
  • Develop, enhance and maintain pricing models in line with Divisional Pricing Standards.
  • Provide individual risk pricing support for complex and large commercial risks.
  • Deliver robust management reporting and analysis relating to rate adequacy and portfolio performance.
  • Produce monthly pricing governance reports, trackers and exhibits.
  • Participate in Rate Adequacy Working Group meetings and provide analytical insights to support decision-making.
  • Conduct reviews of actuarial pricing models to ensure compliance with internal governance requirements.
  • Support pricing governance audits and independently validate model outputs and data integrity.
  • Lead governance reviews while mentoring and supporting junior team members.
  • Partner closely with Underwriting teams on portfolio management, budgeting, remediation activities and strategic initiatives.
  • Support divisional and regulatory reporting requirements.
  • Collaborate with Pricing and Model Office teams to improve pricing platforms and processes.
  • Contribute to projects focused on pricing innovation, model optimisation and governance enhancement
You will ideally possess:
  • Actuarial qualification or significant progress towards qualification.
  • Minimum 4 years' experience in General Insurance Pricing, ideally within short-tail pricing.
  • Experience developing and enhancing Risk Premium Models and Generalised Linear Models (GLMs).
  • Strong understanding of pricing governance and rate adequacy principles
  • Experience with Python
  • Exposure to Earnix would be highly regarded.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement capability.
  • Ability to translate complex actuarial analysis into meaningful business insights.
What's on Offer
  • Join a globally recognised insurance organisation.
  • Highly visible role with direct interaction across actuarial, underwriting and portfolio management teams.
  • Opportunity to broaden your pricing governance and commercial actuarial expertise.
  • Flexible hybrid working environment.

We are currently seeking an experienced Change Analyst to join the a ferderal government agency across a Funding and Disclosure Reform (FAD) Program.

job.title: Director - Operational Risk & Compliance
job.description:
Ethos BeathChapman is partnering with a highly regarded investment and capital management organisation to appoint a Director, Operational Risk & Compliance.
This is a newly created leadership role within the second line of defence, offering the opportunity to shape and enhance enterprise-wide risk and compliance capability within a growing and purpose-driven organisation.
The role has a particular focus on ensuring that technology, cyber, data and information risks are appropriately governed within the broader operational risk management framework. Working closely with first-line business, operations and technology teams, you will help strengthen risk governance, operational resilience and control effectiveness across the organisation.

Key Responsibilities
  • Provide second-line oversight, advice and challenge across operational risk, compliance and resilience activities.
  • Support the development and enhancement of enterprise risk management frameworks, policies and governance arrangements.
  • Partner with business and technology stakeholders to improve risk identification, assessment and treatment processes.
  • Provide oversight of business, cyber, data and information risk management practices from an enterprise risk perspective.
  • Contribute to operational resilience, business continuity and incident management programs.
  • Support the design and implementation of effective risk and compliance controls across key business processes.
  • Deliver risk reporting and insights to executive and board-level stakeholders.
  • Assist with assurance activities, audit remediation and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Promote a strong risk culture through coaching, stakeholder engagement and practical risk advice.
About You
We are interested in speaking with risk professionals who bring a balanced background across operational risk, compliance and governance, together with exposure to data, information and cyber risk management.
You may currently be working in operational risk, enterprise risk, compliance, operational resilience, internal audit or risk advisory within financial services, funds management, banking, insurance or another highly regulated environment.

To be successful, you will likely demonstrate:
  • Experience operating within a second-line risk or compliance function.
  • Strong operational risk and control framework expertise.
  • Knowledge of prudential, regulatory or governance frameworks relevant to regulated organisations.
  • Exposure to technology, cyber, data or information risk management, ideally from a governance and oversight perspective rather than a purely technical role.
  • Experience supporting operational resilience, business continuity or incident management programs.
  • Exceptional stakeholder engagement and influencing skills.
  • The ability to communicate complex risk matters clearly and pragmatically to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience preparing executive-level and board reporting.
Why Consider This Opportunity?
This is an opportunity to join a growing organisation at an important stage of its evolution.
The role offers genuine breadth across enterprise risk, compliance, operational resilience, technology and cyber governance, making it well suited to individuals seeking a diverse and commercially relevant risk leadership position.

For further information on this role or to confidentially apply, please contact Matt Quinn on (02) 8227 9200 or email at mattq@ethosbc.com.au

job.title: Financial Crime Surveillance Analyst
job.description:
We are partnering with a prominent Financial Services institution seeing experienced Financial Crime professionals to support a range of regulatory and operational initiatives across Customer Due Diligence (CDD), Enhanced due Diligence, AML Investigations, Transaction Monitoring, and quality control.

This role is ideal for candidates with at least 3 years experience in Financial crime, AML, KYC, PEPs or Financial Crime Operations who have worked across one or more key financial crime disciplines and are comfortable operating in fast-paced environments.
The successful candidate will join a specialist team responsible for protecting the organisation from financial crime risks while ensuring compliance with regulatory obligations and internal standards.

Key Responsibilities;
Customer Due Diligence (CDD) & Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD)
Conduct CDD and EDD reviews for new and existing customers.
Assess customer risk profiles and identify financial crime risk indicators.
Review KYC documentation and verify customer information.
Analyse complex ownership structures, beneficial ownership, source of wealth, and source of funds.
Complete periodic reviews and remediation activities.

AML Investigations
Investigate alerts, referrals, and unusual customer activity.
Conduct detailed customer and transactional analysis.
Identify potential money laundering, fraud, sanctions, or terrorism financing risks.
Escalate suspicious activity in accordance with internal procedures.
Maintain thorough and accurate case records.

Transaction Monitoring
Review and investigate transaction monitoring alerts.
Assess customer behaviour against expected activity patterns.
Identify potentially suspicious transactions and emerging risk trends.
Document findings and recommend appropriate actions.
Ensure adherence to regulatory requirements and service-level expectations.

Quality Control & Assurance
Perform quality reviews of completed AML, KYC, CDD, EDD, and investigation cases.
Identify quality gaps, process inconsistencies, and training opportunities.
Support continuous improvement initiatives and compliance monitoring.
Ensure case management standards and regulatory requirements are consistently met.

Skills & Experiences;
Minimum of 3 years' experience within Financial Crime operations, AML, KYC, Compliance or Financial Crime Risk Functions
Experience working within Banking, Wealth Management, Payments, Insurance, Professional Services or other regulated financial services environments

Experience in one or more of the following;
- Customer Due Diligence (CDD)
- Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD)
- AML Investigations
- Transaction Monitoring
- Quality Control / Quality Assurance
- KYC Remediation
- Customer Onboarding Reviews

Strong understanding of AML/CTF regulations and financial crime risk frameworks
Exposure to sanctions screening, PEP reviews, adverse media screening and/or suspicious activity investigations
Excellent analytical and investigative skills
Ability to assess risk and make sound judgement-based decisions
Strong written and verbal communication skills
High attention to detail and ability to manage competing priorities

job.title: Senior IT Infrastructure Engineer (Cloud Operations & DR)
job.description:
Client introduction
Our client is an established financial institution licensed and regulated by the Monetary Authority of Singapore, serving business customers across the region. Backed by a well-capitalised international technology group, it operates a cloud-first estate with a small on-premise footprint retained for disaster recovery.
 
The bank is now hiring a Senior IT Infrastructure Engineer (Cloud Operations & DR) to take broad ownership of its cloud infrastructure, operational resilience and day-to-day infrastructure services. This is a senior individual contributor role within a deliberately lean team reporting into senior technology leadership. It will suit someone who remains genuinely hands-on while being equally comfortable with vendors, incidents, regulatory expectations and stakeholders across Singapore and China.
 
Job responsibilities
  • Own and operate the bank's production cloud infrastructure, covering deployment, configuration, optimisation, monitoring, capacity planning and cost management
  • Lead disaster recovery and business continuity planning, testing and remediation, ensuring critical services can be restored within agreed recovery objectives and preparing the supporting evidence for audit and management review
  • Manage the limited on-premise and disaster recovery environment, including hardware, networking equipment, maintenance and technology refresh
  • Manage patching and vulnerability remediation in line with internal policy and agreed service levels, including pre and post deployment validation
  • Lead infrastructure incident and problem management, coordinating internal teams and vendors through resolution, root cause analysis and post-incident reporting
  • Maintain monitoring and alerting across the estate, proactively identifying performance, availability and security risks
  • Own the bank's local infrastructure relationship with the wider group network function, specifying requirements, reviewing designs and holding delivery to account
  • Manage cloud and hybrid network connectivity, including routing, firewalls, segmentation, DNS and connectivity between production and disaster recovery environments
  • Oversee cloud providers, data centre partners and technology vendors, covering due diligence, service quality review, escalation and performance management
  • Partner with cybersecurity stakeholders on access controls, vulnerability management, infrastructure hardening and audit readiness
  • Contribute to infrastructure design and continuous improvement, including automation and infrastructure-as-code initiatives, periodic architecture reviews, and opportunities to improve operational efficiency through AIOps
 
Job requirements

Essential
  • At least 8 years across IT infrastructure, cloud operations or infrastructure engineering, with meaningful experience gained inside a bank or other MAS-regulated financial institution
  • Strong hands-on ownership of production cloud infrastructure on AWS, Azure, GCP or Alibaba Cloud. This is an operating role, not an oversight one
  • Proven ownership of disaster recovery and business continuity exercises end to end, including failover testing, remediation and preparation of evidence for audit or management review
  • Sound understanding of cloud and enterprise networking, including VPCs, subnets, routing, peering, hybrid connectivity, DNS, firewalls and network segmentation. This role requires solid network competence rather than specialist network engineering depth
  • Experience managing infrastructure incidents, root cause investigation, problem management and post-incident reporting
  • Working knowledge of patch management, vulnerability remediation, access controls and infrastructure security within a regulated environment
  • Practical familiarity with infrastructure-as-code and DevSecOps, such as Terraform, deployment pipelines and controlled production change
  • Experience managing cloud providers, managed service partners, data centre vendors and other external suppliers
  • Familiarity with IT service management, change management and operational service levels
 
Advantageous
  • Experience with Alibaba Cloud in a production environment
  • Cloud or networking certifications such as AWS, Azure, GCP, Alibaba Cloud or CCNA, although equivalent practical experience will be considered
 
Why you should join them
  • Ownership without layers. This is one of a small number of people responsible for the infrastructure of an entire licensed bank, working directly with senior technology leadership. Decisions are made and implemented quickly, and whoever takes this seat will see the consequences of their own work.
  • Breadth that is difficult to find elsewhere. Cloud, resilience, networking, security partnership, vendor management and architecture all sit within this role. At a larger institution each would belong to a different team, and progression would mean going narrower rather than wider.
  • A modern estate rather than a legacy one. The bank was built cloud-first from the outset, so the work is running and improving a current environment rather than managing accumulated technical debt.
  • Regulated standards with a smaller operating culture. The resilience and governance expectations are those of a licensed bank, while the team size and pace are closer to a technology company. That combination is genuinely hard to find, and it builds a profile that travels well.
  • Backing and regional reach. The bank sits within a well-capitalised international technology group, giving exposure to group platforms, regional engineering practice and a customer base extending well beyond Singapore.

BeathChapman Pte Ltd
Licence no. 16S8112

job.title: Regional Trade Marketing Manager, SEA
job.description:
The Opportunity
We are partnering with a fast-growing global FMCG organisation to appoint a Regional Trade Marketing Manager to strengthen its commercial and trade marketing capabilities across the region, with Southeast Asia (SEA) as the key priority market.

Operating within a regional matrix structure, this role will be responsible for translating brand and commercial strategies into impactful channel and shopper activation plans. You will work closely with regional and local Sales, Marketing, Trade Marketing teams and distributor partners to accelerate brand penetration, strengthen in-store execution, and drive sustainable sales growth across priority SEA markets.

This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced trade marketing professional who combines regional strategic thinking with strong hands-on execution across diverse and distributor-led markets.

About the Company
Our client is a rapidly expanding global food and consumer goods organisation with an established portfolio of well-recognised brands. With ambitious international growth plans, the organisation continues to invest in strengthening its commercial capabilities, distribution footprint, and consumer relevance across Southeast Asia.

Key Responsibilities

Regional Channel Strategy & Planning
  • Develop and execute regional trade and channel marketing strategies, with SEA as the primary market focus, across Modern Trade (MT) and General Trade (GT).
  • Translate brand strategies and campaigns into locally relevant channel execution plans across priority SEA markets.
  • Develop channel and customer segmentation strategies to identify and prioritise commercial growth opportunities.
  • Partner with local Sales teams and distributors on joint business planning and market execution.

Shopper Marketing & In-Store Excellence
  • Develop shopper marketing programmes that drive brand trial, conversion, basket size, and sales growth.
  • Create scalable regional execution toolkits covering POSM, planograms, promotional mechanics, and in-store visibility.
  • Partner with SEA markets to adapt regional initiatives based on local shopper missions, channel dynamics, and cultural relevance.
  • Champion best-in-class in-store execution and consistency across priority brands and channels.

Trade Promotion & Commercial Effectiveness
  • Develop and optimise trade promotion strategies across channels, seasons, and key commercial campaigns.
  • Evaluate promotional mechanics, bundling strategies, and trade investments to identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Monitor promotional effectiveness and ROI, translating performance insights into actionable recommendations.

Shopper Insights & Category Execution

  • Ensure consistent brand execution while enabling appropriate localisation across individual markets.

Stakeholder & Capability Development

  • Coach and develop trade marketing capabilities across regional and local teams.
  • Drive continuous improvement in trade marketing processes, tools, and ways of working.

Requirements

  • Strong leadership and coaching capabilities with experience developing trade marketing talent and organisational capabilities.

  • Entrepreneurial, agile, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced and evolving environment.

What's on Offer
  • Opportunity to shape the SEA trade marketing strategy within a rapidly growing global FMCG organisation.
  • High-impact regional role with Southeast Asia as the core growth market.
  • Strong exposure to commercial strategy, shopper marketing, and distributor-led market development.

job.title: IT Manager (Infrastructure & Security)
job.description:
Client introduction
Our client is an established Singapore-based investment firm with a lean, senior, and collaborative working environment. The firm is deliberate about staying compact, is rigorous in how it operates, and places technology at the centre of the business. It is now hiring a hands-on IT Manager to take full ownership of its infrastructure, security, and day-to-day IT environment. This is a broad role for someone who wants to stay close to the technology while also owning IT planning, risk, vendors, and new technology initiatives, with significant autonomy over the firm's entire technology estate.
 
Job responsibilities
  • Own the firm's day-to-day IT infrastructure, operations, and security environment end to end, and drive delivery of the IT roadmap.
  • Act as the escalation point for complex IT matters, and manage 1 IT Support Analyst who handles first and second line support.
  • Administer the Microsoft cloud environment (Microsoft 365, Azure, Intune) and related infrastructure services, keeping systems reliable, secure, and fit for purpose.
  • Oversee cyber security controls, including endpoint protection, vulnerability and patch management, access controls, and incident response, with oversight of an outsourced security partner.
  • Own disaster recovery and business continuity, running regular testing and closing identified gaps.
  • Maintain IT policies, standards, the risk register, and governance documentation, and report to management on performance, risk, projects, and expenditure.
  • Manage IT vendors from selection through to performance, and own the IT budget, technology renewals, and infrastructure improvements.
  • Lead firmwide adoption of AI and emerging tools, setting usage standards and identifying practical, high-value use cases.
  • Partner with business stakeholders to scope requirements and deliver approved technology projects and system integrations.
 
Job requirements
  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • At least 7 years of relevant experience across IT infrastructure and operations, including experience taking ownership of IT environments and responsibilities of increasing scope.

job.description:
Experience level: Senior (8+ years)

About the Role
We are seeking an experienced, delivery-focused Senior Delivery Manager to lead end-to-end product and software delivery across the full lifecycle — from inception and planning through development, deployment, and post go-live support.

You will own the delivery outcome: ensuring product objectives, scope, compliance requirements, milestones, and dependencies are clearly defined, communicated, tracked, and met. You'll work closely with the Project Management Team, engineering, design, operations, and business stakeholders to deliver against agreed scope, quality, budget, and schedule.

This role also carries Scrum Master responsibilities, and — where no dedicated Operations Manager is in place — may extend to operational coordination and readiness for smooth transition into production.

Key Responsibilities
  • Lead end-to-end delivery of large-scale, high-impact, or mission-critical programmes, ensuring objectives, scope, and compliance requirements are met at every stage.
  • Develop and maintain delivery roadmaps and project plans alongside the Project Management Team, ensuring milestones are achievable, dependencies are managed, and timelines are met.
  • Serve as the primary liaison between engineering, the PMT, and business stakeholders — communicating delivery status, risks, issues, and decisions clearly and consistently.
  • Remove blockers and provide clarity on priorities and requirements so the engineering team can deliver against product objectives.
  • Champion Agile and product delivery best practices: sprint planning, backlog management, retrospectives, and continuous improvement. Cover the Scrum Master role.
  • Proactively identify, track, and manage delivery risks and issues, escalating and driving timely resolution.
  • Embed governance and assurance checkpoints so deliverables meet compliance, regulatory, and quality standards.
  • Drive programme governance frameworks, reporting structures, release planning, operational readiness, and stabilisation activities.
  • Manage executive stakeholder engagement, steering committees, and senior management reporting.
  • Coordinate multi-vendor and cross-functional delivery across engineering, design, operations, and business teams.
  • Mentor Delivery Managers, Scrum Masters, and delivery teams to strengthen delivery capability, and support resource strategy and prioritisation discussions.

Requirements
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Business, Project Management, IT, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent professional experience with demonstrated impact.
  • Minimum 8 years of relevant experience in software delivery, project delivery, programme management, Agile delivery, or product delivery management, with demonstrated experience managing complex end-to-end delivery.
  • Proven track record as a Delivery Manager, Programme Manager, Agile Delivery Lead, Scrum Master, or equivalent, managing end-to-end delivery across the full SDLC.
  • Strong, hands-on grasp of Agile and Scrum — sprint planning, backlog management, continuous improvement.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage roadmaps, plans, milestones, dependencies, and cross-functional workstreams.
  • Excellent stakeholder engagement and communication skills across business and technical teams.
  • Strong risk and issue management capabilities.
  • Familiarity with compliance, regulatory, governance, and quality requirements in a software delivery context.
  • Sufficient technical literacy to understand delivery blockers, priorities, and dependencies (hands-on coding not required).

Preferred
  • PMP, CSM, CSPO, SAFe, PRINCE2, CITPM, or equivalent certification.
  • Track record managing complex enterprise or mission-critical programmes and large stakeholder groups.
  • Deep understanding of enterprise governance, release management, and operational readiness.
  • Experience in multi-vendor, cross-functional delivery environments.
  • Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, MS Project, Miro, or equivalent.

job.description:

This is a rare opportunity to shape the organisation's first-line technology risk capability, providing strategic leadership across AI governance, data analytics risk and emerging technology risk. Strong understanding of AI, GenAI, cloud technologies, cyber security, data governance, advanced analytics, and emerging technologies.
Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Data Analytics, Cyber Security, Risk Management, or a related discipline.

This is a career-defining opportunity to build a new enterprise capability at one of Australia's leading listed financial services organisations. job.title: Senior Data Engineer
job.description:
About the Client
This client is a leading Australian wealth management company that provides superannuation, financial advice, and asset management services. the company traces its origins back to 1846.

About the Role
We are seeking an experienced Senior Data Engineer to join a high-performing Data Engineering team delivering enterprise-scale data solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). This is a hands-on engineering role where you'll design, build and optimise modern data pipelines that enable trusted, scalable data for reporting, analytics and business decision-making.
Working closely with Solution Designers, Data Architects and cross-functional technology teams, you'll play a key role in delivering robust batch and real-time data solutions while driving engineering best practices, mentoring team members and contributing to the continuous improvement of the data platform.

Required Experience:
- Design, develop and maintain scalable batch and real-time data pipelines on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
- Build robust ETL/ELT solutions to ingest, integrate, transform and model data from multiple enterprise source systems.
- Collaborate with Solution Designers, Data Architects and business stakeholders to deliver data solutions aligned to business and technical requirements.
- Develop high-quality, production-ready code using modern software engineering practices.
- Optimise data pipelines for performance, scalability, reliability and cost efficiency. Implement automated testing, monitoring and CI/CD practices to support reliable production deployments.
- Conduct code reviews and provide technical guidance to engineers and delivery partners.
- Troubleshoot production issues, perform root cause analysis and implement long-term improvements.
- Champion engineering standards, reusable frameworks and continuous improvement initiatives across the data engineering function.
- Work collaboratively within Agile delivery teams and contribute to sprint planning, estimation and technical design discussions.

About You
You'll be a passionate Data Engineer who enjoys solving complex engineering problems while delivering reliable, scalable data solutions within enterprise environments.

You'll bring:
- 10+ years' experience in Data Engineering, Software Engineering or ETL Development.
- Strong commercial experience delivering enterprise data solutions on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
- Expertise with BigQuery, Dataflow, Cloud Composer (Airflow), Pub/Sub and Cloud Storage.
- Advanced SQL skills and strong programming experience with Python (Java or Scala also beneficial).
- Strong understanding of ETL/ELT frameworks, data integration and modern data engineering principles.
- Experience designing dimensional data models and enterprise data warehouse solutions.
- Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, Git, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform preferred) and automated testing.
- Strong understanding of data quality, metadata management, monitoring and observability.
- Experience tuning data pipelines for performance, scalability and reliability.
- Excellent stakeholder engagement and communication skills, with the ability to work across Architecture, Security, Infrastructure and business teams.
- Previous experience mentoring engineers and performing technical code reviews.

Nice to Have
- Experience with streaming technologies such as Pub/Sub or Kafka.
- Experience working within Financial Services, Insurance or other highly regulated industries.
- Exposure to DataOps, DevOps and modern cloud engineering practices.
- Experience with containerisation technologies such as Docker or Kubernetes.
- Google Cloud certifications.

What's on Offer
Opportunity to work on a large-scale enterprise cloud data platform.
Modern GCP technology stack and engineering-led environment.
Collaborative, high-performing team with strong technical leadership.
Exposure to enterprise architecture, cloud transformation and modern data engineering practices.
Flexible working arrangements with hybrid/remote options.

Exposure to complex, large-scale investment activity

Key Responsibilities
  • Lead the development of closure packs, assessment papers and programme governance documentation.
  • Draft executive and Board-level reporting, including papers for Audit & Risk Committees and senior governance forums.
  • Establish and apply quality assurance processes across key programme deliverables.
  • Develop assessment criteria and assurance frameworks to support programme outcomes.
  • Review evidence and deliverables to ensure completeness, consistency and alignment with agreed requirements.
  • Provide Line 1 risk and compliance assurance across a range of workstreams.
  • Engage with senior stakeholders to challenge, refine and improve the quality of programme outputs.
  • Support governance forums through the preparation of high-quality reporting and decision papers.
About You
To be successful, you will bring:
  • Experience within banking or a highly regulated financial services environment.
  • Strong Line 1 Risk, Compliance, Assurance or Controls experience.
  • Exceptional written communication skills, including experience producing executive-level reports and governance papers.
  • Demonstrated experience preparing submissions for Executive Committees, Boards and Audit & Risk Committees.
  • A strong understanding of non-financial risk management frameworks and governance practices.
  • Experience reviewing, challenging and quality assuring complex programme deliverables.
  • Proven ability to operate effectively within large, multi-stakeholder programmes.

This is an opportunity to join a strategically important programme where you will work closely with senior leaders and influence key governance and assurance outcomes.
The role offers a highly visible platform for an experienced risk and compliance professional who enjoys combining assurance expertise with high-quality executive writing and stakeholder engagement.

job.title: Data Migration Test Lead
job.description:
About the Client
The client is is a major Australian wealth management company that provides superannuation, asset management, and financial advice services. Listed on the ASX 200, it manages approximately $330 billion in funds and operates well-known brands globally.

About the Role
I'm seeking an experienced Senior Data Migration Test Lead to join a major enterprise transformation program involving the migration of critical operational data to a new platform. This is a hands-on role requiring someone who can independently lead end-to-end data migration testing, ensuring the accuracy, completeness, and integrity of migrated data throughout the testing lifecycle. This is not a traditional testing role - we're looking for someone who has owned data migration testing on large-scale transformation programs and can proactively identify, investigate, and resolve data issues with minimal guidance.

Required Experience:
Key Responsibilities
Lead the end-to-end data migration testing lifecycle across a large enterprise transformation program.
Develop and execute data validation, reconciliation, and verification strategies to ensure migration accuracy.
Analyse and investigate data discrepancies, identifying root causes across source systems, ETL processes, and target platforms.
Collaborate closely with data engineers, developers, and business stakeholders to resolve defects and validate data transformations.
Validate complex ETL processes and data warehouse migrations.
Deliver testing outcomes autonomously within fast-paced project timelines.

Skills & Experience
12+ years' experience in data migration, ETL, or data warehouse testing.
Proven experience leading end-to-end testing for large-scale enterprise data migration projects.
Strong SQL skills with the ability to perform complex data validation and reconciliation.
Hands-on experience with IBM DataStage and/or Informatica.
Experience with Oracle Data Warehouse environments.
Exposure to BigQuery and Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
Knowledge of SSIS, Kafka, and modern data integration technologies is highly regarded.
Ability to work independently with minimal direction in a complex delivery environment.

Ideal Background
You'll have worked on large enterprise transformation or migration programs within industries such as financial services, banking, insurance, or superannuation. You'll be someone who has owned testing workstreams—not simply executed test cases—and is confident making decisions, investigating issues, and driving successful migration outcomes.

job.title: FP&A Analyst
job.description:
An exciting opportunity exists for an ambitious and commercially minded FP&A Analyst to join a high-performing finance team within a leading global professional services organisation.  Reporting to the FP&A Manager, this hands-on role will play a key part in delivering accurate, insightful and timely financial reporting, budgeting and forecasting support across the business. The Opportunity

As an FP&A Analyst, you will be responsible for producing high-quality management reporting, analysing financial performance, supporting planning processes and helping drive continuous improvement initiatives across the finance function.
You will develop a deep understanding of the commercial drivers of the business while partnering with a diverse range of stakeholders across operational and corporate teams.

  • Experience within financial analysis, management reporting, budgeting and forecasting (highly regarded)
  • Advanced Excel skills with the ability to work confidently with large and complex data sets.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

  • Opportunity to join a highly regarded global organisation.

job.title: Senior CyberArk Engineer
job.description:
About the Client
The client is one of Australia’s largest profit-to-member superannuation funds. They are recognized as a responsible investment leader who values simplicity, action, and grit.

About the Role
The specialist will join an industry-leading InfoSec team to lead the design, engineering, and operation of the Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) platform, focusing primarily on hands-on technical delivery. This high-impact role involves a blend of greenfield and existing projects, requiring the Analyst to drive major design decisions, mentor junior analysts, and help shape the strategic direction of the identity function.

Required Experience:
Design, implement, and manage CyberArk Privileged Cloud solution to secure privileged accounts and sensitive credentials across the enterprise.
Lead the installation, configuration, and maintenance of CyberArk privileged Cloud components including Vault, PAS, PVWA, CPM, PSM, and PTA.
Monitor and maintain daily operations of PAM systems to ensure high availability, optimal performance, and robust security of privileged access.
Oversee the full lifecycle management of privileged accounts, provisioning, deprovisioning, credential rotation, and auditing—across platforms such as CyberArk Privilege Cloud, Microsoft Entra ID, and SailPoint Identity Security Cloud (ISC).
Conduct regular privileged access reviews, ensuring strict adherence to the principle of least privilege and compliance requirements.
Investigate and respond to security incidents or anomalies related to privileged access, working closely with the incident response team for swift resolution and root cause analysis.
Partner with IT and application teams to integrate PAM solutions seamlessly with critical enterprise systems and tools.
Develop and enforce policies governing privileged access in line with security frameworks and compliance standards.
Manage patching, upgrades, and troubleshooting of all CyberArk components, ensuring a secure and stable environment.
Provide technical expertise, guidance, and training to internal teams and end-users on best practices in identity and access management.
Perform regular audits and generate detailed reports on privileged account usage, policy violations, and compliance status.
Identify and resolve issues related to authentication, access controls, and application integration within the broader identity ecosystem.
Maintain comprehensive documentation of configurations, processes, and operational best practices across all supported identity platforms.

If you are interested to find out more and meet the key requirements outlined please apply with your CV.

job.title: Quantitative Investment Modelling Specialist
job.description:
My client is looking to appoint a Quantitative Investment Modelling Specialist to work across investment product design, valuation, and risk modelling within a highly specialised quantitative team.

Responsibilities
Contribute to the design of investment and retirement product solutions by applying quantitative modelling. techniques to structure analysis and decision support.
Develop and enhance pricing, valuation, and risk models used to assess product features and portfolio exposures
Perform scenario analysis and Monte Carlo simulation to evaluate how products behave under different market conditions, including stress and tail events.
Translate product requirements into quantitative model specifications and ensure assumptions are clearly defined and testable.
Analyse model outputs to identify sensitivities, key risk drivers, and performance characteristics across different economic environments.
Work closely with investment, actuarial, product, and risk stakeholders to communicate findings and support decision-making processes.
Support model validation, documentation, and internal review processes, ensuring outputs are well-documented and suitable for governance use.
Assist in improving existing modelling frameworks, tools, and methodologies to increase efficiency, accuracy, and robustness.

What you’ll need
6+ years’ experience in quantitative finance, financial engineering, market risk, ALM, or related analytical roles.
Strong understanding of stochastic processes, numerical methods, and simulation-based modelling techniques .
Hands-on experience building or maintaining pricing, valuation, or risk models in a production or near-production environment.
Advanced programming skills in Python, C++, MATLAB, or equivalent languages used for quantitative analysis.
Ability to interpret complex model results and communicate insights clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Experience working across investment, product development, or risk functions in a structured finance or insurance environment.
Exposure to structured investment products, retirement solutions, or long-term liability-driven products. advantageous.
Strong analytical judgement with the ability to balance model complexity against practical usability.

Must have PR / Citizenship for Australia - please email me on rupinderk@ethosbc.com.au if keen to explore.

job.title: Financial Accountant
job.description:

A leading Australian-based digital asset platform operating within a regulated financial services environment, the organisation provides secure trading, custody, and infrastructure services for cryptocurrencies and other digital assets.

My client is seeking a CA or CPA-qualified Accountant with 3+ years of experience to join their Sydney-based finance team. This is a newly created, broad, and hands-on role covering core accounting activities including financial reporting, tax compliance, and day-to-day financial operations.

  • Strong career growth potential

job.title: Manager Group Performance & FP&A
job.description:
This is a fantastic opportunity to play a central role in how a large ASX-listed banking group understands and manages its Group cost base.  Sitting within Group Finance, you’ll deliver clear, driver-based insights on expense performance across forecasts, targets, and peer benchmarks—supporting Executive and Board decision-making.  Working closely with divisional, functional, and line-of-business finance teams, you’ll translate complex expense data into concise, actionable insights. You’ll explain cost movements, challenge assumptions, contribute to planning and target setting, and provide forward-looking scenario analysis to improve financial outcomes.
Key deliverables include:
  • Deliver driver-based analysis of Group expense performance, including cost base, cost growth, and key expense categories against forecasts, targets, and peer benchmarks
  • Provide clear variance analysis, commentary, and forward-looking insights for senior Finance stakeholders
  • Support Executive and Board reporting through robust modelling, sensitivity analysis, and scenario planning
  • Partner with divisional, functional, and business finance teams to enhance the quality of expense insights and decision-making
  • Maintain strong controls across data, models, and reporting outputs, including reconciliations, review checks, and documentation
  • Identify and implement opportunities to simplify, standardise, and automate reporting to improve speed, accuracy, and impact
This role will provide you with the following:
  • High visibility role with exposure to senior stakeholders and Executive-level reporting
  • Opportunity to deepen your FP&A and performance analytics capability
  • Collaborative and supportive team environment within Group Finance
  • Flexible hybrid working arrangements
  • Strong development and career progression opportunities
Key requirements for this role include:
  • CA / CPA qualification (desirable)
  • Banking / Financial Services experience preferred, but open to demonstrated group-level experience in a large ASX-listed commercial organisation.
  • A foundational understanding of planning, forecasting, and performance reporting cycles
  • Strong Excel skills, with exposure to TM1 or similar enterprise planning / GL systems
  • Developing capability in financial modelling, variance analysis, and scenario planning
  • The ability to interpret financial data and communicate clear, actionable insights
  • Strong attention to detail, with a strong control mindset and developing commercial judgement
  • Exemplary communication and stakeholder engagement skills, with confidence in presenting insights
  • Experience with BI and reporting tools, and comfort working with large data sets
Next steps: If this sounds like the role for you, please apply via the link or reach out to Stuart Soper directly on 8227 9200.

job.title: Senior Consultant – UK
job.description:
Ethos BeathChapman (EBC) is a global group of executive talent and recruitment experts in Australia, Asia and EMEA, with a broader network beyond. Our vision is to connect the world’s exceptional companies to exceptional people.

Established 2005 in Sydney, Ethos BeathChapman’s mid-sized agility and solutions-focused approach enables us to flex where traditional recruitment agencies have failed, and scale beyond the reach of small boutiques with executive recruitment solutions that address the client’s specific needs.

Part of Will, EBC has six offices worldwide in Australia, Singapore, Hong Kong, Japan, Netherlands and the UK. We own Quay Appointments in Australia and CONNECT, EBC’s AI-powered sourcing specialists.

On an international basis, our multidisciplinary expertise covers specialised functions across Banking & Financial Services, Fintech, Technology, Legal & Compliance, Industrial, Consumer, Healthcare and Life Sciences recruitment markets, among others.

At the heart of EBC is how we deliver upon that vision via our progressive behaviours and forward-thinking way of performing. We look to break tradition and truly embrace modern technology, data and analytics as well as best in class enablement support to deliver market leading executive recruitment solutions, tailored for our clients and candidates.

We are living in a changing world – and here at EBC we strive to approach it in a changing way.

​In the UK, we are a start-up organisation seeking leverage EBC’s international client base and to build brand new business on top of that. The key focus will be helping our clients achieve their change & transformation goals via permanent recruitment, interim management and executive search. This is a truly exciting opportunity for someone who wants to help shape and build the UK business, as well as their own personal client base. There will be significant opportunities for personal development as the UK business grows in line with our ambitious plans.

www.ethosbc.com | www.linkedin.com/company/ethos-corporation |
 
The Role:
As a Senior Consultant, you will be in an exceptional role unlike elsewhere: one which truly aims and is designed to take already very strong performers to the next level of exceptional performance. Embark on your strategic journey to develop your candidate and client base alike, as well as accelerating your start with our existing client base and global lead network. You will have the opportunity to work alongside extremely talented and experienced colleagues, as well as innovate with outcomes to deliver strong business mix to clients across search, projects, retained and executive contracting. Take the opportunity to plunge yourself into our progressive ways of working, learn our AI technology, state-of-the-art cloud-based CRM platform and engage heavily with cutting edge talent engagement, marketing, data analysis and research functions that set EBC uniquely apart to take already strong performers to your exceptional performance level.

At Senior Consultant level, EBC engages with you around more strategic client initiatives, regional business development and training around future leadership. You will also be autonomous, able to define business plans competently and work at high level towards wider company outcomes.
​
Experience and Qualifications:
We are looking for high performing, entrepreneurial and collaborative recruiters/headhunters with outstanding work ethics and passion for being the best in your specialised recruitment domain.

You will have at least 3 to 6 years’ experience as a recruitment professional working in an executive search/recruitment firm – whether in large agencies, headhunters, boutiques or otherwise, we are keen to hear from you. You’re able to show evidence of strong revenue performance, existing client networks and growing ability to broadly influence both internally and externally.
University level education and experience within change & transformation recruitment are preferred but not essential.

You will have excellent communication skills, both written & verbal, with a natural flair for relationship building at a senior level.

You will be excited by the prospect of joining a start-up business but with the backing of an existing, successful recruitment business.
​
Location: Initially remote (primarily) with ad-hoc internal meetings (likely locations London and Reading). In the medium-term (Q1 2023), office location will likely be London (Paddington)
​
Our Culture:
A career with EBC revolves on several key principles.

Firstly, joining a mature, high performing group of experts requires people with a strong strategic, highly focused and collaborative approach both internally and across all clients and candidates.

Secondly, our commitment to new ways of working and enablement, data-driven decision-making and AI technology is not just held by upper management but is lived and breathed throughout the organisation. We aim for all new joiners to hold good passion and commitment to innovate, share new ideas and work in forward thinking ways like these.

Lastly, and perhaps most importantly, we are an organisation which values internal relationships as much as external. Being persistent in delivering a world-class service and interactions across colleagues, clients and candidates alike is paramount.

Throughout your journey, we are committed to your success. On hand you will always have the high-powered and finessed support – not just from the experienced mentors on your team at your doorstep, but also the supporting technology, our lead network and our best-in class enablement support function.

job.title: Senior Consultant – Financial Services (Front Office)
job.description:
Ethos BeathChapman (EBC) is a global group of executive talent and recruitment experts in Australia, Asia and EMEA, with a broader network beyond.

We provide solutions across key recruitment markets including Financial Services, Fintech & Technology, Finance & Corporate Functions, Legal, Commercial and Life Sciences - our vision is to connect the world’s exceptional companies to exceptional people.

At the heart of EBC is how we deliver upon that vision via our progressive behaviours and forward-thinking way of performing. We look to break tradition and truly embrace modern technology, data and analytics as well as best in class enablement support to deliver market leading executive recruitment solutions, tailored for our clients and candidates.

We are living in a changing world – and here at EBC we strive to approach it in a changing way.
​
The Role:
As a Senior Consultant, you will be in an exceptional role unlike elsewhere: one which truly aims and is designed to take already very strong performers to the next level of exceptional performance. Embark on your strategic journey to develop your candidate and client base alike, as well as accelerating your start with our existing client base and global lead network. You will have the opportunity to work alongside extremely talented and experienced colleagues, as well as innovate with outcomes to deliver strong business mix to clients across search, projects, retained and executive contracting. Take the opportunity to plunge yourself into our progressive ways of working, learn our AI technology, state-of-the-art cloud-based CRM platform and engage heavily with cutting edge talent engagement, marketing, data analysis and research functions that set EBC uniquely apart to take already strong performers to your exceptional performance level.

At Senior Consultant level, EBC engages with you around more strategic client initiatives, regional business development and training around future leadership. You will also be autonomous, able to define business plans competently and work at high level towards wider company outcomes.
 
Experience and Qualifications:
We are looking for high performing, entrepreneurial and collaborative recruiters/headhunters with outstanding work ethics and passion for being the best in your specialised recruitment domain.

You will have at least 3 to 6 years’ experience as a recruitment professional working in an executive search/recruitment firm – whether in large MNC agencies, headhunters, boutiques or otherwise, we are keen to hear from you. You’re able to show evidence of strong revenue performance, existing client networks and growing ability to broadly influence both internally and externally.
​
Our Culture:
A career with EBC revolves on several key principles. Firstly, joining a mature, high performing group of experts requires people with a strong strategic, highly focussed and collaborative approach both internally and across all clients and candidates. Secondly, our commitment to new ways of working and enablement, data-driven decision-making and AI technology is not just held by upper management but is lived and breathed throughout the organisation. We aim for all new joiners to hold good passion and commitment to innovate, share new ideas and work in forward thinking ways like these. Lastly, and perhaps most importantly, we are a boutique who values internal relationships as much as external. Being persistent in delivering a world-class service and interactions across colleagues, clients and candidates alike is paramount.

Throughout your journey, we are committed to your success. On hand you will always have the high powered and finessed support – not just from the experienced mentors on your team at your doorstep, but also the supporting technology, our lead network and our best-in class enablement support function.

This is what your career at EBC could look like: www.ethosbc.com/careers
​
About the Company:
Established 2005 in Sydney, Ethos BeathChapman’s mid-sized agility and solutions-focused approach enables us to flex where traditional recruitment agencies have failed, and scale beyond the reach of small boutiques with executive recruitment solutions that address the client’s specific needs.

In Asia, our multidisciplinary expertise covers specialised functions across Banking & Financial Services, Fintech, Technology, Legal & Compliance, Industrial, Consumer & Healthcare recruitment markets, among others. Part of Will, EBC has six offices worldwide in Australia, Singapore, Hong Kong, Japan, Netherlands and the UK. We own Quay Appointments in Australia and CONNECT, EBC’s AI-powered sourcing specialists.

www.ethosbc.com | www.linkedin.com/company/ethos-corporation | #BeExceptional

Never let yourself or EBC become stagnant. Become a forward-thinking systems expert and get yourself ahead-of-the-curve with latest methodologies, ways of recruiting and headhunting. See the chance to take on extra responsibility as opportunities to develop yourself, learn new skills, become more able and impact the business.

job.title: Senior Consultant - Insurance
job.description:
About EBC
Established in 2005 Ethos BeathChapman are a global executive search firm with a presence in Australia, Asia and EMEA.
Passionate about staying innovative, we embrace progressive ways of working and new technologies, and adopt an agile mindset to deliver market leading executive recruitment solutions.
We provide solutions across Financial Services, Fintech & Technology, Legal, Commercial and Life Sciences - our vision is to connect the world’s exceptional companies to exceptional people.

The role
  • As a Senior / Principal Recruitment Consultant you will be responsible for the full recruitment lifecycle, including account management and new business development, sourcing for talent, and executing cross-border placements.
  • You will leverage our existing accounts with direct insurers, reinsurers, consultancies, brokers and work in tandem with our Senior Director who has over 10 year’s experience in Insurance
  • Exceed client expectations by building robust relationships based on mutual trust and respect, and developing a detailed understanding of each client’s organisation and recruitment needs
  • Continually challenge yourself to create and deliver tailored and innovative search solutions across retained, exclusive, contingent, contracting, and special projects (market mapping, talent pipelining, EVP build-out, etc.)
  • Proactively look to challenge yourself towards Directorship either as an individual contributor or a team leader and support wider company initiatives as and when required
  • Engage heavily with our broader internal functions across Talent Engagement, Marketing, Data Analysis, Sourcing Excellence, L&D, etc. to drive both personal and business growth
  • This is one of the most lucrative desks in the company with extremely high billing potential
 
What we are looking for?
  • 2-10+ years relevant recruitment experience whether in large MNC agencies, boutiques, executive search, etc.
  • Passion for being the best in your specialised domain and becoming the “go-to” expert
  • Ability and track record of strong revenue performance and client network
  • An outgoing, resilient, and driven personality
 
What is in it for you?
EBC will give you access to senior stakeholders whilst working on a broad variety of markets, exposure to retained and exclusive recruitment, access to a warm client base, and access to state of the art enablement functions, Other benefits also include:
  • Highly competitive base salary and uncapped commission
  • Flexible Work Arrangement
  • Luxury Incentive Trips
  • Health and Dental Insurance
  • Gym Membership
  • Mature and autonomous culture
